tracadamia.skill.half_cold_half_hot.desc: Cold grants Cold Resistance; Hot grants Heat Resistance. Mastery unlocks Phosphor, Thermal Fluctuation Resistance, and every move. Crouch Switch to enter Phosphor. Ice Wall: 1,000 aura, 20s cooldown, immobilizes for 60s. Ice Glide: 20 aura per second. Ice Spikes: 200 aura, 2s cooldown. Flashfire Fist: hold a 30-block flame beam for up to 3 seconds, 25 heat every 0.25s, 1,000 aura, 30s cooldown. Jet Kindling: 500 aura per melee burst. Wall of Flames: 500 aura, 10s cooldown. Pale Blade: a traveling heat/cold disc dealing 200 cold and 200 heat. Great Glacial Aegir: 30x30, 300 cold and 100 heat that bypasses heat resistance. Switching is free.
tracadamia.skill.half_cold_half_hot.aegi: Great Glacial Aegir: next melee attack armed
tracadamia.skill.half_cold_half_hot.grou: Look at a grounded living target within 30 blocks.
tracadamia.skill.half_cold_half_hot.targ: Look at a living target within 30 blocks.
tracadamia.skill.explosion.description: Quirk: Explosion. Heat Nullification and Flame Attack Resistance. Toggle Explosive Attacks to add up to 100 heat on melee. Modes unlock with mastery: Explosive Speed, Stun Grenade, AP Shot / Scattershot, Explode-A-Pult, Land Mine Blast, Howitzer Impact, and Cluster.
tracadamia.skill.explosion.too_low: Howitzer Impact requires at least %s blocks of height
tracadamia.skill.all_for_one.description: Quirk: All For One. If it's freedom you desire, then submit to me, my brethren. And bear witness, by my side. This impending void era will give rise to a more perfect demon lord. This will be the story of how I became the greatest demon lord of all!
tracadamia.skill.smokescreen.description: Release a dome of smoke. You can see through your own cloud, but others cannot. Holding costs 1% of maximum AP every 3 seconds. Sense skills are suppressed for everyone inside, including you. Aspersion conceals your presence while slotted.
tracadamia.skill.electrification.descrip: Absorb lightning for a damage boost. Shock attackers while toggled. Discharge nearby or throw a charge that sticks for 30 seconds and can be detonated with a second press.
death.attack.electric_discharge: %1$s was caught in an electrical discharge
death.attack.electric_targeted: %1$s was struck by an electrical burst
tracadamia.skill.bloodcurdle.description: Quirk: Bloodcurdle. Sword and blade quirk hits cause bleeding. Use Blood Paralysis on a bleeding target to stop their movement.
tracadamia.skill.muscle_augmentation.shi: Cannot use Muscle Overload: Strike while shielding
tracadamia.skill.blackwhip.description: Quirk: Blackwhip, The user can generate tendrils of black energy from their body capable of swinging around or binding foes can also be used to spear through foes.
tracadamia.skill.quirk_bestowal.descript: Quirk: Quirk Bestowal, A seemingly weak skill with the sole ability to pass itself on...
tracadamia.skill.quirk_bestowal.passed: The hope for a miracle has been bestowed upon you, go and take this beyond
tracadamia.skill.quirk_bestowal.pass: A flicker of you're will has been bestowed to another...

tracadamia.skill.power_stock.description: Quirk: Power Stock, Stockpile power as you grow and release it for a empowered strike
tracadamia.skill.one_for_all_1.descripti: Quirk: One For All, The first person cultivates the power, and then passes it on to another. The next refines it and passes it on again. In this way, those crying out to be saved and those with brave and true hearts link to form a crystalline network of power!

tracadamia.skill.voice.description: From Birth!: Voice gains two mastery points per use. Loud! makes chat messages deal sound damage in a 30-block cube for one aura per character. Mastered Voice deals 1.5x damage.
